Godrej Properties launches Rs 6,000 crore luxury project in Mumbai

Godrej Properties has launched a new luxury housing project in Mumbai's Marine Lines area. The project is expected to generate Rs 6,000 crore in revenue. This development strengthens the company's luxury portfolio in the Mumbai market.
